# Papa Kojo Mensah

> Papa Kojo Mensah is an operations and customer experience professional based in Ghana and open to thoughtful work globally. He uses trusted data, practical digital tools and clear design to make complex work easier to understand and use.

## Canonical profile

- [Professional profile](https://pkm.hayalows.com/): About, projects, experience, skills, education, contact information and a personal Spotify listening panel.
- [One-page CV](https://pkm.hayalows.com/resume/): Concise, printable curriculum vitae.
- [Project index](https://pkm.hayalows.com/projects/): Focused summaries and canonical links for three published projects.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/papakojomensah): Public professional profile.

## Current positioning

- Primary focus: operations and customer experience.
- Supporting strengths: data quality, record review, Excel, Google Sheets, process documentation, project coordination, brand identity and graphic design.
- Current role: Data Entry Specialist at Springboard, remote, from April 2026.
- Education: BSc Actuarial Science, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, 2024.

## Selected projects

- [RouteLab](https://maps.hayalows.com/): A map-first tool for planning, remembering and exploring everyday movement.
- [Hayalows Ventures](https://hayalows.com/): Brand, customer-journey, operations and practical-systems work.
- [English Chat Finder](https://englishchatsession.vercel.app/): A search tool across more than 200 conversation calendars.

## Contact

- Email: mpapakojo@gmail.com

## WebMCP browser tools

- `get_papa_kojo_profile` returns only public identity, positioning, location, availability and canonical profile links.
- `get_papa_kojo_skills` returns one exact capability group or all three published groups.
- `get_papa_kojo_experience` returns one exact organization record or all three published roles.
- `get_papa_kojo_education` returns one exact qualification or all published education and training records.
- `get_papa_kojo_projects` returns one exact published project or all three projects with canonical live links.
- `prepare_papa_kojo_email` prepares and focuses a reversible email draft link but never opens the mail app, sends a message or books time.
- These tools are available across the professional profile, project index and one-page CV so an agent can complete the same bounded journey from each public context.
- Stable, versioned result contracts: https://pkm.hayalows.com/webmcp/results.schema.json
- Every tool registers an `outputSchema` and returns matching `structuredContent`.
